title: Biblical Fasting Seminar: Part #1
description: Join us on Wednesdays, November 11 and 18, as we explore the biblical purpose and practice of fasting. Together, we’ll discover how fasting can deepen our dependence on God, strengthen our prayer lives, and help us grow in our walk with Christ.
excerpt_html:
Join us on Wednesdays, November 11 and 18, as we explore the biblical purpose and practice of fasting. Together, we’ll discover how fasting can deepen our dependence on God, strengthen our prayer lives, and help us grow in our walk with Christ.

title: Melodies of Christmas Production at Idlewild
description: 🎄You are invited to join our Seniors Ministry as they attend the annual Christmas Production at Idlewild Baptist Church! “Melodies of Christmas,” Saturday, December 12, 4 PM. Meet at Faith at 2:15 PM. Tickets $18 by cash or check, $20 online. Sign up by Monday, November 16.
excerpt_html:
🎄You are invited to join our Seniors Ministry as they attend the annual Christmas Production at Idlewild Baptist Church!

“Melodies of Christmas” — Saturday, December 12, 4 PM to 6 PM, at Idlewild in Tampa.
body_html:
🎄You are invited to join our Seniors Ministry as they attend the annual Christmas Production at Idlewild Baptist Church!

“Melodies of Christmas” — Saturday, December 12, 4 PM to 6 PM, at Idlewild in Tampa.

Meet at Faith at 2:15 PM, leaving at 2:30 PM. From the church property, you may drive separately or carpool to Idlewild in Tampa. The group plans to stop for dinner after the production before returning to Faith.

Tickets: 36 reserved, first-come, first-served. Your ticket will be reserved when payment is received.

Cost: $18 if paying by cash or check made payable to Faith Baptist Church (memo: “Idlewild Christmas Production”); $20 if paying online.

Tickets will be available until Monday, November 16.

Sign up
